$comment: A small, experiment-first screening tranche from the 100-patch image
book. Duplicate examples strengthen an existing semantic identity; they
do not become extra idioms. No source text or images are stored here.
Every page is patch number plus seven. Semantic hashes cover the same
topology/minimum/forbidden structure used to detect catalogue duplicates.

duplicates.reason: The source example is the existing oscillator-to-filter voice with an envelope controlling brightness; its named instrument setting does not create a new cable identity.
Multiple close oscillators share slow pitch movement, which is already the canonical ensemble-vibrato fragment; the source adds a setting example, not another topology.
The multiplied oscillator pair and struck resonant body are already represented by bell-tone; a tubular-chime setting is corroboration, not a distinct checked structure.
A slow source moving oscillator pitch is the canonical vibrato identity; the instrument label and knob positions do not add a checkable connection.
